iTRAK Stop All movers command 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Sends a cascaded MAS to all Movers given the input dynamics.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Error Description 1002 Device Handler faulted 1003 Device Handler is not in a supported state. Device Handler must be in state Available 1005 iTRAK is not energized 1010 Cfg_StopType out of bounds. Valid values are 0 <= Cfg_StopType <= 10. 1011 Cfg_DecelRate out of bounds. 1012 Cfg_DecelJerk out of bounds
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 4,0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for iTRAK MF Multi track system. 3.1 - Event fields match Machine Builder standards order. 3.0 - iTRAK Medium Frame Device Handler 3.0.00. Hndl structure modified to support both iTRAK Medium Frame and iTRAK5730 parameters. 1.0 - First Release
